name: Purple Fandisk
original_name: パープルファンディスク
source:
Fandisc among other goodies includes a single visual novel piece. Kasumi from Kasumi Yuugi introduces Kasumi Yuugi 2 by giving production commentaries and even presenting opening of the sequel.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Fan Disc中除了其他好东西外，还包含一部视觉小说作品。《霞游戏》中的霞通过制作评注来介绍《霞游戏2》，甚至展示了续作的开场动画。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
